capabilities: Apply highlight, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough or text colour on selection release
Mix multiple styles in a fixed nesting order
Toggle the pen and pick styles from the status bar
Skip protected regions such as code, math, links and frontmatter
Configure colour palettes, output format and hotkeys
disambiguation: Not a drawing or annotation tool; it styles text selections with existing markdown and HTML markup.
extras: Desktop only (the status bar does not exist on mobile) and requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it because existing commands for bold, italic and highlight cost a keystroke or menu trip per selection, and marking up long notes adds friction.
problem: Obsidian's formatting commands work one selection at a time, each costing a keystroke or menu trip, which adds friction when marking up long notes.
summary: Selection-based formatting tool that applies highlight, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough or colour to text the moment the mouse is released.
